text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the first step to becoming a Triple Crown champion—the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio seems to have pre-race jitters for once. She's clearly feeling the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her nerves calm down after I give her some advice. She leaves excitedly for the track, ready to wow the crowd with her performance.
